purpose: Remove window-boundary and right-edge ambiguity before any trade outcome is calculated.

semantics.entry_time_definition: the UTC open timestamp of the complete 4H bar immediately after the signal bar closes
semantics.window_end: entry_time must be < scored_entry_end_exclusive_utc or data_end_exclusive_utc as applicable
semantics.full_path_requirement: entry_time + 24 hours (six complete 4H held bars) must be <= the window/data end boundary; otherwise the candidate is RIGHT_EDGE_INELIGIBLE and is excluded before outcome inspection
